items.detail: The **Nasdaq** fell 0.44% to 27,245.90 Monday while the S&P 500 barely moved, slipping 0.06% to 7,807.24, as tech was the weakest sector.
items.why: Micron dropped about 3.9% on fears that Chinese rival CXMT is catching up in memory chips.

items.detail: Energy led the S&P 500 as Brent climbed about 1% to just over **$105**, undoing Friday's dip on Trump's Iran comments.
items.why: Deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia's main airport, and Trump weighing US strikes in Yemen, revived supply fears.

items.detail: Big-bank earnings kick off this week, and Wednesday's **CPI report** is the main test of whether higher oil is feeding back into inflation.
items.why: A hot print would strengthen the case for another Fed hike after September's increase.

items.detail: Korea's **Kospi** plunged about 7% below 6,000 Tuesday as it reopened from the holiday, with SK Hynix down over 9%. Taiwan fell about 2%.
items.why: China's CXMT showed a denser DRAM design, and foreigners dumped Samsung and SK Hynix on fears for memory profits.

items.detail: The **Nifty** fell 0.70% to 22,363.35 Monday, giving back Friday's rebound, after the Sensex swung more than 1,200 points from its intraday high.
items.why: Crude above $105, a three-year high in bond yields and ₹1,708 crore of foreign selling weighed on banks and FMCG.

items.detail: India's **Nifty Smallcap 100** bucked the selloff and rose **1.42%** Monday, even as the large-cap Nifty fell 0.7%.
items.why: Domestic investors bought about ₹3,045 crore and focused on smaller stocks, offsetting foreign selling of large caps.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** slipped about 2% to near **$81,950** early Tuesday after briefly reaching $84,150 Monday, so the bounce from its sub-$81,000 low faded.
items.why: A firmer dollar before Wednesday's CPI and $681 million of weekly spot ETF outflows weighed on prices.

items.detail: **Ether** fell about 3.7% to around **$2,450** early Tuesday, slipping back toward last week's low near $2,406.
items.why: Spot ether ETFs extended their outflow streak to nine days, losing $542 million last week.

items.detail: **Solana** dropped about 5% to near **$106** Tuesday, below Friday's $110, even as a new Solana ETF launched in Hong Kong.
items.why: US Solana ETFs posted their biggest weekly outflow since launch, ending a 14-week run of inflows.

items.detail: **Gold** fell about $24 to **$4,169.50** Monday, slipping back from Friday's brief move above $4,200.
items.why: Traders cut positions before Wednesday's US inflation data, and higher oil added to fears of more rate hikes.

crossCuttingTheme: China's CXMT memory-chip breakthrough is hitting the AI hardware trade from Micron to the Kospi, while Brent back above $105 is lifting rate-hike fears before CPI, dragging on gold and crypto.
